description: Use at the start of a non-trivial task. Checks your proposed outcome and definition of done (DoD) against Flow's contract rules, chooses the quick or full path, and returns DoD item IDs, a signed contract token and the first step. Computes only; stores nothing. Save the token in your goal file.
